title: I could have…
goal: Say what could or couldn't have happened with -(Y)p bilerdi and -(Y)p bilmezdi, and follow a family memory.

intro.text: Put *bilmek* in the **used to** form: *Sen maňa jaň edip bilerdiň!*, you could have called me! The negative says what wasn't possible: *Sizsiz men muny edip bilmezdim*, I couldn't have done this without you.

vocab.en: to work as (sürüji bolup işlemek: to work as a driver)

exercises.question: Which is **you could have called me**?

why.1: *edip bildiň* says you did manage to call.
why.2: *bilersiň* is now or later: **you can call me**.
why.3: *jaň etmelidiň* is **you should have called me**: a little stronger.

exercises.explain: *bilmek* with `-ArdY`: *jaň edip bilerdiň*, you could have called.

exercises.label: *gitmek*: I could have gone, you could have gone…

exercises.en: I couldn't have done this without you.

reject.why: *edip bilmedim* is **I wasn't able to do it**, but you did do it. For what wouldn't have been possible: *bilmezdim*.

exercises.explain: *bil-* + *-mez* + *-di* + *-m*: *edip bilmezdim*, I couldn't have done it.

exercises.prompt: Biz awtobus bilen hem gidip bilerdik.
accept: We could have gone by bus too.
We could also have gone by bus.
We could have gone by bus as well.
We could have taken the bus too.

reject.why: *aýdyp bildiň* says you managed to tell me. For a chance you didn't take: *aýdyp bilerdiň*.

exercises.title: Atamyň durmuşy
exercises.passage:
Meniň atam ýetmiş ýaşynda. Öň ol Tejende ýaşardy, indi biziň bilen Aşgabatda ýaşaýar. Çagaka atam her gün ir turardy. Ol ilki goýunlara seredýärdi, soňra pyýada mekdebe barardy. Mekdep uzakdy, ýöne ol hiç haçan gijä galmazdy.

Atam gowy okaýardy. Ol lukman bolup bilerdi, ýöne on dört ýaşynda işlemeli boldy, sebäbi onuň kakasy kesel boldy. Şondan soň maşgala şähere göçdi. Atam Aşgabatda otuz ýyl sürüji bolup işledi. Durmuş köp üýtgedi. Ýöne atam heniz hem her gün ir turýar we köplenç öňki durmuş barada gürrüň berýär.
exercises.translation: My grandfather is seventy. He used to live in Tejen; now he lives with us in Ashgabat. As a child, my grandfather got up early every day. First he looked after the sheep, then he walked to school. The school was far, but he was never late. My grandfather was a good student. He could have become a doctor, but at fourteen he had to work, because his father fell ill. After that the family moved to the city. My grandfather worked as a driver in Ashgabat for thirty years. Life has changed a lot. But my grandfather still gets up early every day and often talks about life in the old days.

questions.q: Where did the grandfather use to live?
questions.explain: *Öň ol Tejende ýaşardy*: he used to live in Tejen; now he lives in Ashgabat.

questions.q: Why didn't he become a doctor?
options: He had to work when his father fell ill.
He was often late for school.
questions.explain: *on dört ýaşynda işlemeli boldy, sebäbi onuň kakasy kesel boldy*.

options: It was possible, but it didn't happen.
He didn't want to be a doctor.
questions.explain: `-(Y)p bilerdi`: **could have**. He worked as a driver instead.

exercises.prompt: I couldn't have done it alone.

reject.why: *edip bilmedim* is **I wasn't able to do it**. For what wouldn't have been possible: *edip bilmezdim*.

exercises.explain: *edip bilmezdim*: I couldn't have done it.

exercises.explain: A past habit set against *indi*: *içerdim*, I used to drink.

exercises.text: We could have come, but we had no time.
Sen maňa kömek edip biler___, ýöne etmediň.
exercises.en: You could have helped me, but you didn't.

reject.why: *bilersiň* is **you can**, now or later. For a chance in the past: *bilerdiň*.

exercises.explain: *biler* + *-di* + *-ň*: *kömek edip bilerdiň*, you could have helped.

exercises.prompt: My grandfather used to work as a driver.
exercises.explain: *sürüji bolup işlemek*, to work as a driver, with `-ArdY`: *işlärdi*.
